title: 1798 Revolt of the Alfaiates
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1798 Revolt of the Alfaiates", at revision 1375770643, opens: "The Bahian Conspiracy, also known as Revolt of the Tailors–after the trade of many of the leaders–and recently also called Revolt of Buzios, was a late eighteenth century slave rebellion in the then Captaincy of Bahia, in the State of Brazil. Unlike the Inconfidência Mineira of 1789, it was a separatist movement with a popular base and extensive black participation." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2993386, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "slave revolt in Bahia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
